properties.headline: Rip Current Statement issued November 13 at 3:46PM ChST until November 14 at 4:00PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 7 to 10 feet in the surf zone.
Dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...North facing reefs of the Marianas.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM ChST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion. Rip currents can sweep even the best
swimmers away from shore into deeper water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Today's surf observations indicate surf of 7
to 10 feet along north-facing reefs. The long-period north swell
that originated from Typhoon Cempaka has most likely peaked today,
but may take more time to subiside. Therefore, large surf and
dangerous rip currents will likely continue through Saturday
afternoon.
properties.instruction:
Rip currents will be life threatening. Inexperienced swimmers
should remain out of the water due to dangerous surf conditions.

Rip currents will be life threatening. If caught in a rip
current, relax and float. Don't swim against the current. If
able, swim in a direction following the shoreline. If unable to
escape, face the shore and call or wave for help.
